The narrow wedge between the median's tip (1045-1093, 2341-2362) and the west ramp's right line is open to the west ramp and labelled street with it. Two short strokes only cut shared road lines at junctions so the land on either side is two areas (they are not printed lines): (1094-1099, 2346) across the boulevard's west line between the median's closing line and the start of the west ramp's right line; (1111-1116, 2350) across the boulevard's east line between the east ramp's two branch points.
